# Logistics

## Practical Quarto: Welcome! {.center .smaller}

**Wifi**: Posit Conf 2026 **Password**: conf2026

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="75%"}
1. Materials: [pos.it/practical-quarto-conf26](http://pos.it/practical-quarto-conf26)

2. Get [Quarto version 1.10](https://quarto.org/docs/download/)

3. Get a copy of exercises: <https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/practical-quarto-exercises>
   - Option 1: Fork and clone the repo or use `usethis::create_from_github("posit-conf-2026/practical-quarto-exercises")`
   - Option 2: Download the zip file and unzip it to your working directory

4. Join the discord: `#workshop-quarto`

## Workshop policies

-   Please review the posit::conf code of conduct, which applies to all workshops: <https://posit.co/code-of-conduct>

-   The Code of Conduct site has info on how to report a problem (in person, email, phone)

-   Please do not photograph people wearing red lanyards
